journey.title: One pilgrim's journey, from the first call to the flight home
journey.body: Everything the office has to write down at each step, the software keeps in order. Each picture on the right is a piece of a real page in the software.

inquiry.title: The first question
inquiry.body: Someone calls or walks in: name, phone, which package they're interested in. It reminds you on the day to call back. Questions from your website land here too.

passport.title: Registration and passport
passport.body: Reading the two lines at the bottom of the passport fills in the name, number and expiry. Each pilgrim gets their own ID, found in a moment.

receipt.title: Instalments and receipts
receipt.body: However many instalments, what's paid and what's due is always in front of you. Every receipt has the amount in words and a QR code that proves it's genuine.

hotel.title: Hotels in Makkah and Madinah
hotel.body: Which pilgrim is in which bed of which room, for how many nights, at what cost in riyal. Nobody can be put in two places on the same night.

journey.title: On the journey
journey.body: Duas and ayat in Arabic with Bangla pronunciation and meaning. The steps of Hajj and Umrah in plain words. Meanings are marked as drafts until a scholar checks them.

books.title: The day's books
books.body: At midnight the day's statement makes itself: what came in and went out, business by business. The same at month and year end. Nothing is ever erased; a mistake is fixed with a reversing entry.

businesses.title: The businesses you run alongside Hajj, in the same ledger
businesses.body: Many agencies also run a shop or a zamzam water round. Each keeps its own books, and at month end they all meet in one statement.

zamzam.title: Zamzam water
zamzam.body: Seven routes for the seven days of the week. How many jars each shop took and what it still owes, written down on the route.

medicine.title: Medicine shop
medicine.body: Stock by batch and expiry date. The batch that expires first is sold first, with a warning before anything runs out of date.

coffee.title: Naba Coffee
coffee.body: Quick sales from the menu, and the day's takings at closing.

supernova.title: Supernova
supernova.body: Product list, sales and dues, a statement every day.

expenses.title: Office costs
expenses.body: Rent, power, transport, hospitality. Each cost with a photo of its voucher, filed under the business it belongs to.

payroll.title: Staff salaries
payroll.body: The month's salary sheet: advances taken off, locked, paid in one go. The payment goes straight into the books.

businesses.logins: Every colleague signs in as themselves. Someone who runs the medicine shop sees only the medicine shop, not pilgrims' details or the office books.

website.title: Every agency gets its own website
website.body: No one to pay to build or run a separate site. Arrange it from inside the software and changes show on the website straight away.

points.look: Your colours, logo, large picture, headline and story
points.posts: Registration news, notices, offers and photos of past journeys
points.reviews: Pilgrims write reviews themselves; they show once you approve them
points.inquiries: Questions from the website go straight to your inquiry list

demo.headline: Your Hajj in trusted hands
demo.body: Hajj and Umrah from Dhaka for 25 years.
demo.review: We were looked after the whole way, alhamdulillah.

security.title: Pilgrims' details, kept safe
security.body: Passports, phone numbers and money are sensitive. The rules for keeping them are strict from the start.

passport.title: Passports stay private
passport.body: Passport numbers and scans are stored encrypted. Even searching never leaves the real number readable in the database.

separate.title: Every agency is walled off
separate.body: No agency can see anything of another's. The wall is inside the database, not just hidden on the page.

device.title: An emailed code for new devices
device.body: Signing in from an unfamiliar phone or computer needs a 6-digit code sent by email, and you're told when a new device is added.

lock.title: Locked after wrong passwords
lock.body: Five wrong passwords in a row pause sign-in for 15 minutes. Weak or common passwords aren't accepted.

audit.title: Every change is on record
audit.body: Who changed what, and when, is written down. Nothing can be erased from the money books.

backup.title: Backed up every night
backup.body: The whole database and all files are backed up every night.

qr.title: Fake receipts get caught
qr.body: Scanning a receipt's QR code checks it against our books and shows whether it's genuine.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.body: Everything in the {plan} plan, free for the first {days} days. Then pick the plan that fits your agency.

closing.title: Let this year's Hajj start in a tidy ledger

book.title: A guide to Hajj, Umrah and prayer
book.subtitle: Surahs of the Quran, every word of the prayer, everyday duas, and what to say at each step of Umrah and Hajj: in Arabic, with Bangla pronunciation, Bangla meaning and English. Read it any time, on any phone.

sources.arabic: Every ayah is taken verbatim from the verified Uthmani text of the Tanzil Project. The Arabic of every dua and hadith is matched letter for letter across two independent copies of Sahih al-Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, Abu Dawud, at-Tirmidhi and Ibn Majah; none of it is typed by hand.
sources.draft: The Bangla pronunciation and the Bangla and English meanings are plain-language drafts not yet checked by a scholar. Bangla letters cannot show every Arabic sound exactly, so learn correct recitation from a teacher.
sources.fiqh: The lists of fard, wajib and sunnah follow the Hanafi school, the one followed in Bangladesh. Ask your group's scholar about your own situation.
sources.hadithCredit: Hadith Arabic: fawazahmed0/hadith-api and AhmedBaset/hadith-json (both from sunnah.com), matched letter for letter.

book.forAgencies: See the full software for Hajj agencies

guide.title: Guide book
guide.body: Surahs, prayer, duas, Umrah and Hajj: Arabic with Bangla pronunciation and meaning

staff.title: Agency staff?
staff.body: Sign in to run pilgrims, payments, receipts, hotels and the shops from your phone.

pilgrim.title: Erase personal details
pilgrim.body: At the pilgrim's request, their name, phone, addresses, family details, passport and NID numbers, every paper and scan, and the audit-trail copies of these are deleted for good. Receipts and the money record stay, under the reference. This can't be undone.
pilgrim.banner: This pilgrim's personal details were erased at their request on {date}. Only the money record is kept.

inquiry.body: This inquiry and its audit-trail copies are deleted for good.

customer.title: Erase customer details
customer.body: At the customer's request, their name, phone, address and area are deleted, and their name is taken out of ledger notes. Sales, payments and dues stay in the books. This can't be undone.

employee.body: At the employee's request, their name, designation, phone and account number are deleted. Salary and advance records stay. This can't be undone.

account.title: Delete my account
account.body: Your login, password, devices, name, email and mobile are deleted for good, and you leave every agency. Receipts and work you recorded stay with the agency, shown as “—”.
account.ownerNote: An agency's owner can't delete their own account, or no one would be left in charge of the agency and its books. To close the agency, contact us.
